question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH best_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id,
        constructor_id,
        MAX(points) as best_driver_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY race_id, constructor_id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT race_id, constructor_id, points as team_points
    FROM constructor_standings
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.constructor_id,
        c.name,
        bp.best_driver_points,
        tp.team_points,
        bp.best_driver_points + tp.team_points as combined_points,
        r.year
    FROM best_driver bp
    JOIN team_points tp ON bp.race_id = tp.race_id AND bp.constructor_id = tp.constructor_id
    JOIN constructors c ON bp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races r ON bp.race_id = r.race_id
)
SELECT constructor_id, name, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined, year
FROM combined
WHERE constructor_id = 131
GROUP BY constructor_id, name, year
ORDER BY max_combined DESC
LIMIT 10
